sample.task:
(In the school literature clubroom...)

Sayori: "MC...there's something I need to tell you. I-I-I don't exactly know how to tell you this..."
sample.chosen:
MC: "Sayori, you can tell me anything. What's on your mind?"

Sayori: "Well, it's just that... I've been feeling a bit overwhelmed with the club activities lately. I'm not sure if I can keep up with everything."

MC: "I understand, Sayori. It can be a lot to handle sometimes. Why don't we sit down and go over your responsibilities together? We can figure out a way to make things more manageable for you."

Sayori: "Thank you, MC. That would be really helpful."

MC: "Of course! We're all here to support each other. And remember, it's okay to ask for help when you need it. We're a team, after all."

Sayori: "You're right. I'm glad I can count on you and the others."

MC: "Always, Sayori. Now, let's get started on finding a solution that works for you."
sample.rejected:
Yuri: "Sayori, what's wrong? You seem troubled. If it's something you're uncomfortable discussing in front of me, we can always find a private place to talk."

Sayori: "N-no, it's not like that... It's just... I have feelings for you, Yuri. I-I've had them for a while now, and I didn't know how to tell you."

Yuri: "Sayori... I... I appreciate your honesty, but I must be honest with you as well. I have feelings for someone else, and it's not you."

Sayori: "I see... I'm sorry if I caused any discomfort. I just wanted to be honest with you, too."

Yuri: "There's no need to apologize, Sayori. I respect your feelings, and I'm glad you felt comfortable enough to share them with me. Let's continue to support each other, regardless of our feelings for one another."

Sayori: "Thank you, Yuri. I appreciate your understanding."

Natsuki: *enters the room, looking flustered* "Hey, guys! I-I'm sorry I'm late! I had to... um... help with something in the kitchen. So, what's going on?"

Yuri: "Natsuki, we were just discussing our feelings for each other. Sayori has feelings for me, and I have feelings for someone else."

Natsuki: "Oh... I see... Well, I'm here for you, Sayori. And, Yuri, if you ever need someone to talk to about your feelings, I'm here for you, too."

Sayori: "Thank you, Natsuki. I appreciate your support."

Yuri: "Thank you, Natsuki. Let's continue to support each other, no matter what."

Natsuki: "Of course! That's what friends are for. Now, let's get back to our club activities and make the most of our time together."

Sayori: "You're right, Natsuki. Let's focus on our literature club and the friendships we share."

Yuri: "Agreed. Let's continue to support each other and enjoy our time together."

Natsuki: "Yay! Let's do it!"

*The three friends continue their club activities, supporting each other and enjoying their time together.*
